description.title: חומרים מהותיים
description.summary: This table lists material matters that must be disclosed to the insurer when applying for insurance. It details information required about the apartment and its contents for accurate risk assessment.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מפרטת חומרים מהותיים שיש לדווח עליהם למבטח בעת הגשת בקשה לביטוח, במסגרת פוליסת אדירה כסף. המידע נדרש לגבי הדירה ותכולתה, לצורך הערכת סיכונים מדויקת. הדיווח כולל פרטים כגון כתובת הדירה, שווי הדירה, סוג הבניין, חומרי הבנייה, מיקום הדירה בבניין, אמצעי הבטיחות, גיל הדירה, גודל הדירה, מספר החדרים, מספר האנשים המתגוררים בה באופן קבוע, תוספות ושינויים מיוחדים. כמו כן, נדרשים פרטים על תכולת הדירה, כולל תיאור הפריטים, שווי התכולה, פרטי מכשירי חשמל (סוג, יצרן, גיל ושווי) ופרטי חפצי ערך. אדירה כסף דורשת גם דיווח על נזקים שהתרחשו בשלוש השנים האחרונות כתוצאה מסיכונים המכוסים בפוליסה, וכן פרטי מבטחים קודמים שביטחו או סירבו לבטח את הדירה או התכולה בשלוש השנים האחרונות.
description.row_axis: category of information required for disclosure

sketch:
47.2 A material matter is a matter in respect of which a question was presented in the insurance proposal - in writing or in any other way which shall be documented by the insurer - and without derogating from the generality of the aforementioned, including the following matters:
47.2.1 Regarding the apartment: the apartment address, value of the apartment, type of the building, building material, location of the apartment in the building, safety measures of any type, age of the apartment, size of the apartment, number of rooms, number of people regularly living in it, additions and special modifications.
47.2.2 Regarding the contents: description of the items constituting the contents, value of the contents, details of the electrical appliances: their type, make, age and value, as well as details of the valuables.
47.2.3 Without derogating from paragraphs 47.2.1 and 47.2.2, regarding the apartment and the contents: damages occurring in the last three years as a result of risks covered by this policy, as well as details of previous insurers which insured or refused to insure the apartment or contents, in the last three years.

טבלה: חומרים מהותיים
This table lists material matters that must be disclosed to the insurer when applying for insurance. It details information required about the apartment and its contents for accurate risk assessment.
ממדים: category of information required for disclosure, details within each category

47.2 A material matter is a matter in respect of which a question was presented in the insurance proposal - in writing or in any other way which shall be documented by the insurer - and without derogating from the generality of the aforementioned, including the following matters:
47.2.1 Regarding the apartment: the apartment address, value of the apartment, type of the building, building material, location of the apartment in the building, safety measures of any type, age of the apartment, size of the apartment, number of rooms, number of people regularly living in it, additions and special modifications.
47.2.2 Regarding the contents: description of the items constituting the contents, value of the contents, details of the electrical appliances: their type, make, age and value, as well as details of the valuables.
47.2.3 Without derogating from paragraphs 47.2.1 and 47.2.2, regarding the apartment and the contents: damages occurring in the last three years as a result of risks covered by this policy, as well as details of previous insurers which insured or refused to insure the apartment or contents, in the last three years.
